name: BotOps · Chief of Staff
tagline: One front door for a whole fleet of working bots
description: Rather than juggling a dozen assistants yourself, you brief this one and it decides who takes the job, handing work down to specialist deputies which in turn spin up short-lived bots for individual tasks. Notion keeps the running record, so it stays obvious what is finished and what is still waiting on you.
author: Matthew
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
